name: gaurify-meet
title: Gaurify Meet
description: See your next meetings, join in one keystroke, share open times and your booking link.
author: gaurify

commands.name: upcoming-meetings
commands.title: Upcoming Meetings
commands.subtitle: Gaurify Meet
commands.description: Your next meetings, grouped by day. Join, copy, cancel or open them.

commands.name: copy-booking-link
commands.title: Copy Booking Link
commands.subtitle: Gaurify Meet
commands.description: Copy the link to your booking page.

commands.name: copy-meeting-type-link
commands.title: Copy Meeting Type Link
commands.subtitle: Gaurify Meet
commands.description: Pick a meeting type and copy its booking link.

commands.name: find-open-time
commands.title: Find Open Time
commands.subtitle: Gaurify Meet
commands.description: See your next open times and copy three of them with your link.

commands.name: new-meeting
commands.title: New Meeting
commands.subtitle: Gaurify Meet
commands.description: Book a meeting on your calendar.

commands.name: join-next-meeting
commands.title: Join Next Meeting
commands.subtitle: Gaurify Meet
commands.description: Open the join link of the meeting that is on now or next.

commands.name: share-open-times
commands.title: Share Open Times
commands.subtitle: Gaurify Meet
commands.description: Copy three open times and your link, no window.

commands.name: open-gaurify-meet
commands.title: Open Gaurify Meet
commands.subtitle: Gaurify Meet
commands.description: Open your Gaurify Meet in the browser.

commands.name: next-meeting
commands.title: Next Meeting
commands.subtitle: Gaurify Meet
commands.description: Your next meeting in the menu bar, with the rest of today below.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Create one in Gaurify Meet: Settings > API & webhooks. It starts with gm_live_.
